class: research recommendation invalid against live code
what_happened: Research report 02's Recommendation 1 proposes emitting 'run-all.sh --only SUITE[,SUITE...] --skip-unchanged', but tests/run-all.sh has no --skip-unchanged flag: its arg loop's catch-all arm exits 2 with 'ERROR: unknown argument'. Only verify-deploy.sh parses the flag. The plan therefore applies --skip-unchanged to the verify-deploy.sh --only-gate invocation ONLY, and leaves the run-all.sh --only invocation unflagged (it already skips the .gate-lock mutex for a narrowed run, so it needs no cache fast path). Adding the flag to run-all.sh was rejected as out of territory: that file is in sibling task 584's declared file_scope this same cycle.
